products.title: Axglo e3 Remote - Electric Golf Push Cart
products.body_html:
Axglo e3 Remote puts you in command with effortless control. No Follow Mode, just intuitive remote operation for a seamless golfing experience.

Remote Control Mode

The wireless remote provides full directional control, allowing you to move the cart forward, backward, left, or right with precision. Easily guide your cart around obstacles or position it exactly where you need it, all without physical effort.

Remote Cruising Mode

With remote cruising control, set your cart to maintain a steady, constant pace using different cruising speeds. Perfect for long fairways, this mode lets you walk comfortably while the cart moves smoothly ahead.

Manual Push Mode

If the battery is depleted or removed, the e3 Remote seamlessly converts to manual push mode, allowing you to continue your round without interruption.

KEY FEATURES

  • Calibrated dual motors for efficient power delivery and stable handling
  • Patent Anti-Tipping Technology, capable of handling slopes up to 40 degrees on various terrains
  • Gyroscope technology maintains straight tracking across slopes and uneven terrain
  • Easy folding and unfolding design for quick setup and transport
  • Speed unit toggle allowing users to easily switch between kilometers (km) and miles
  • Trip and Odometer (ODO) display, enabling golfers to track individual round distance or total cart usage
  • Adjustable handle height suitable for users of all ages and heights
  • Adjustable bag straps to accommodate most golf bags
  • Built-in USB charging port for personal devices
  • Includes beverage holder and umbrella holder

***All Electric Push-Carts are FINAL SALE !

Having Questions? Please contact us at info@axglo.com or 1-416-292-1380 for more information.

Specifications

  • Voltage: 24 V
  • Motor : Dual Powerful Brushless Hub Motors
    • Rated Power: 90W x 2
    • Peak Power: 150W x 2
  • Dimensions: 33.5" (L) × 18.5" (W) × 17" (H) / 85cm (L) x 47cm (W) x 44cm (H)
  • Weight: Without Battery - 14KG
  • With Battery - 16 KG
  • Material: Aluminum
  • Warranty: 24 Months
  • Lithium Battery Capacity: 10050mAh
  • Lithium Battery can be charged on the cart OR off the cart

Charging Instructions

  • Fully charge both the battery and the remote before first use. 
  • Battery charging time: 4–5 hours.
    • When the battery is fully charged, the charger light turns green.
    • We recommend charging the battery before every round of golf.
  • Remote charging time: 1–2 hours.
    • While charging, the % number on the remote will increase.
    • Once fully charged, the display shows 100.
    • When the battery is low (below 15%), the % number will flash.
    • Use only the standard adapter for charging; fast adapters will not work.
  • For first-time use, remove the protective plastic cover from the power socket before inserting the battery.
    • Insert the battery by placing it into the base first, then press down firmly until you hear a click.

How to Use

  • How to fold and Unfold Axglo e3 Remote? 
    • To Unfold: Pull both rear wheels of your e3 outwards by about 3 cm. Release the upper and lower triggers, grab the handle, and pull the cart backward to unfold it. Then, lock the upper and lower lock triggers.
    • To Fold, Release the lower lock trigger and hold the handle. Then, release the upper lock trigger and fold the cart inward. Lock the upper and lower lock triggers.
  • How to turn on / off the Axglo e3?
    • The cart's power switch is positioned on the lower right side of the display screen. 
    • Press and hold for 2 seconds to turn on / off the cart 

           

  • How to activate Remote control mode? 
    • Press the power key once on the remote control and the LED will light up blue
    • When the % digits flash, it means the remote's battery is too low
    • Direction keys: Forward/Reverse/Left Turn/Right Turn Key
  • How to activate Remote cruising mode? 
    • Press the cruising button on the remote control, Press it again to exit the cruising mode. (At this point, the cart is in lock mode, press lock/stop button to unlock the cart)
    • Forward Button (+) acceleration 
    • Reverse Button (-) deceleration 
    • Turning in : Press and hold left / right turn button
    • ** Memory Function: Next cruise starts at the last set speed.
  • What does the Remote function indicator light mean?
    • Red: Locked/Stop
    • Yellow: Remote Control Mode
    • Green: Cruising Mode
    • Blue: Unlocked/Standby/ Manual Push

Safe Use of Your Cart

  • Maximum load capacity: 20kg
  • Submerging the cart in water will cause damage to the cart. We recommend using the manual push mode while crossing a bridge or in a limited space, like a parking lot.
  • Before transportation, the battery must be disconnected from the cart.
  • When parking on a slope, please do not turn off the power and remember to press the stop key. Turning off the power would disable the electric braking system of the cart.
  • Do not store your cart in the open air.
  • When it rains heavily, protect the cart from the rain and try to cover it with an umbrella.
  • Please use a soft dry towel to wipe off the excess mud, dirt or water from the cart.
  • Keep the main folding track clean and well lubricated.
  • The battery will be able to complete around 36 holes on a single charge when used in normal conditions (however this is not guaranteed). We encourage users of Lithium batteries to top-up between rounds whenever possible. The battery is not designed to complete 18 holes over consecutive days on a single charge. Battery capacity will reduce over time and can be affected by frequency of use and charging conditions.
  • Do not remove the battery during rainy conditions.

Warranty

Axglo electric golf push cart and charger have a 2-year warranty from the date of purchase. The warranty covers product problems or manufacturing defects. Axglo will bear the shipping costs for sending parts or transporting the electric golf push cart to Canada in the event of manufacturing defects. 

Failures due to accidental damage, improper use (wear and tear), self-dismantling or misuse are not covered. 

The standard warranty guarantee is subject to the following exclusions: 

  • Accidental damage, abuse or misuse 
  • Abnormal wear and tear
  • Rental or commercial usage 
  • Product modification 
  • Repairs by an unauthorized service technician 
  • Failure to follow battery charging instructions 
  • Failure to follow battery storage instruction 
  • Discharging battery to lower than 8 volts. 
  • Removal or defacing of serial numbers from any item invalidates the warranty.

products.title: Axglo e5 Follow - Electric Golf Push Cart
products.body_html:
Axglo e5 redefines walking golf with intelligent follow mode, powerful assisted drive, and advanced remote control.
Built for smooth performance and total freedom, Axglo e5 keeps you in command, every step of the way.

Understand the Icons on screen

  • There are a total of 5 control modes available, which encompass follow me, power-assisted speed control, remote control, remote cruising, and manual pushing.
  • “Follow me” option where Axglo e5 will follow you everywhere you go.
  • To utilize the power-assisted speed control feature (which offers a total of 9 speeds), simply turn the central knob in a clockwise direction to increase the speed, and in an counter clockwise direction to decrease it.
  • The wireless remote control enables full directional control, allowing for movement in all directions such as forward, backward, leftward, and rightward.
  • With the remote cruising control feature, you can set your cart to run at a constant speed using one of its three available speeds. 
  • Gyroscope technology maintains straight tracking across slopes and uneven terrain
  • If the battery runs out of power or is not installed, the cart can be pushed manually.
  • Calibrated dual motors for efficiency and optimal handling.
  • With our Patent Anti-Tipping Technology, our cart is capable of climbing up to a 40-degree slope on any terrain.
  • Effortless and easy 2-Motion folding and unfolding of Axglo e5 for quick and easy setup.
  • Fully adjustable handle height for all height and age groups.
  • Adjustable bag strap for most bags of any size.
  • USB Charging port to power any personal devices (Mobile Phone etc.).

  • Comes with Beverage holder, Umbrella holder, Magnetic Holder and Phone Holder.

    ***All Electric Push-Carts are FINAL SALE !

    Having Questions? Please contact us at info@axglo.com or 1-416-292-1380 for more information.

Specifications

  • Voltage: 24 V
  • Motor : Dual Powerful Brushless Hub Motors
    • Rated Power: 90W x 2
    • Peak Power: 150W x 2
  • Dimensions: 25” (L) x 16.5” (W) x 15” (H) / 64cm (L) x 42cm (W) x 38cm (H)
  • Weight: Without Battery - 3.8lbs
  • Weight: With Battery - 35lbs
  • Material: Aluminum
  • Warranty: 24 Months
  • Lithium Battery Capacity: 10050mAh
  • Lithium Battery can be charged on the cart OR off the cart

Charging Instructions

  • Fully charge both the battery and the remote before first use. Watch this quick charging guide
  • Battery charging time: 4–5 hours.
    • When the battery is fully charged, the charger light turns green.
    • We recommend charging the battery before every round of golf.
  • Remote charging time: 1–2 hours.
    • While charging, the remote’s power button flashes red slowly.
    • Once fully charged, the remote will turn off automatically.
    • Use only the standard adapter for charging; fast adapters will not work.
  • For first-time use, remove the protective plastic cover from the power socket before inserting the battery.
    • Insert the battery by placing it into the base first, then press down firmly until you hear a click.

 

How to Use

  • How to fold and Unfold Axglo e5? Watch how to fold / unfold 
    • To Unfold: Pull both rear wheels of your e5 outwards by about 3 cm. While holding the grey circle button on the side, pull up the front wheels to lock them in place. Release the upper and lower triggers, grab the handle, and pull the cart backward to unfold it. Then, lock the upper and lower lock triggers.
    • To Fold, Release the lower lock trigger and hold the handle. Then, release the upper lock trigger and fold the cart inward. Press the grey square button on the front bag support to release the front wheels, then fold them downward. Lock the upper and lower lock triggers.
  • How to turn on / off the Axglo e5?
    • Press and hold the power switch for two seconds (The cart is in lock mode)
    • Press the power switch once to unlock the cart or through Axglo App or remote control
  • How to activate the Power-Assisted Speed Control? Watch the video to see how it works
    • Press the power switch twice.
    • Rotate the central dial clockwise: Accelerate (Max speed: 9km/h)
    • Rotate the central dial counter clockwise: Decelerate (Min speed: 0km/h)
    • To stop the cart/exit the assisted speed control mode: Press the power switch once (at this time, the cart is in lock mode)
    • Press the power switch again. The Cart is now unlocked and in standby state.
  • How to activate the Follow Me mode? Watch the video to see how it works
    • Press the "doggie" key, press again to exit the follow mode. 
    • Place the remote control in your back pocket for better connectivity with the cart.
  • How to activate Remote control mode?
    • Turn on the power key on the remote control and move the joystick (central key) towards the direction you want the cart to move. 
  • How to activate Remote cruising mode? Watch the video to see how it works
    • Turn on the power button on the remote control, then quickly push the joystick (central key) straight upward twice to activate Speed 1 (0–4 km/h). 
    • Push up again to Speed 2 (5-7km/h)
    • Push up for the third time to Speed 3 (7-9km/h)
  • What does the Remote function indicator light mean?
    • Red: Locked
    • Yellow: Remote Control
    • Green: Follow Me
    • Blue: Unlocked/Standby/ Manual Push
  • How to Use the Axglo App Control? Watch the video to see how it works 
    • To get started, turn on your cart and open the Axglo app. It will automatically connect to the cart via Bluetooth.
    • Once connected, the main screen will display key information like current speed, battery levels, trip and total mileage, and remote control status.
    • In the “Details” section, you’ll find system version information, remote battery level, and the option to update firmware if needed.
    • Under “Settings” you’ll be able to switch between kilometers and miles, adjust the steering and cycling sensitivity, and customize how the cart follows you.
    • Steering sensitivity controls how sharply the cart turns with the remote; the higher the setting, the more responsive it becomes, we recommend setting this to 100 for the best experience.
    • Cycling sensitivity determines how smoothly the cart responds in follow mode. For more stable performance, we suggest turning off the automatic adjustment and setting the value manually to 1.
    • Following angle settings allow for precise control of how the cart tracks behind you. To ensure smooth performance, avoid negative values. A recommended range is between 5° and 20°. You can also set the follow distance, with 1.5 meters being a safe and reliable choice.
    • Cruising speed can be set to your preference, choose from Speed 1, 2, or 3 when using Cruise Control Mode.
    • If you are uncertain, we recommend using the settings below, as they provide a stable and well-balanced experience for most user.

Safety & Maintenance

  • Watch this quick video for maintenance tips
  • Maximum load capacity: 20kg
  • Submerging the cart in water will cause damage to the cart. We recommend using the manual push mode while crossing a bridge or in a limited space, like a parking lot.
  • Before transporting the cart, be sure to disconnect the battery. If the cart will not be used for an extended period, fully charge the battery and store it separately from the cart.
  • When parking on a slope, please do not turn off the power and remember to press the stop key. Turning off the power would disable the electric braking system of the cart.
  • Do not store your cart in the open air.
  • When it rains heavily, protect the cart from the rain and try to cover it with an umbrella.
  • Please use a soft dry towel to wipe off the excess mud, dirt or water from the cart.
  • Keep the main folding track clean and well lubricated.
  • The battery will be able to complete around 36 holes on a single charge when used in normal conditions (however this is not guaranteed). We encourage users of Lithium batteries to top-up between rounds whenever possible. The battery is not designed to complete 18 holes over consecutive days on a single charge. Battery capacity will reduce over time and can be affected by frequency of use and charging conditions.
  • Do not remove the battery during rainy conditions.

In what situations does the remote control vibrate?

  • When the remote control's battery is low.
  • When there is an obstruction between the remote control and the cart, such as a passing person or another vehicle.
  • When the distance between the remote control and the cart exceeds the maximum range.
  • When the battery power drops below 10%, the remote control will vibrate intermittently as indicated in the manual.
  • When a cart equipped with anti-crash bumper sensor detects an obstacle.

Failures due to accidental damage, improper use (wear and tear), self-dismantling or misuse are not covered.

products.title: Axglo V1 Golf Push Cart
products.body_html:
Axglo V1 Golf Push Cart - Ultra Compact

  • Our V1 Push Cart is the most compact in its class, designed to save storage space. It features a quick-release rear wheel system, allowing you to remove the wheels easily and save even more space.
  • Front wheel is fixed and does not swivel, offering more stability on course terrain
  • The V1 Push Cart has 2 separate large storage consoles , carries more accessories and makes them organized.
  • Our patent 1 step folding design allows you to set up the cart in few seconds, simply pull up the handle with 1 foot lightly step on top of the front wheel. 
  • We have the optional storage bag available (Sold Separately), keeps your trunk clean and carry your cart with you easily.
  • Offers excellent maneuverability and provides easier navigation
  • Simple engage and release hand brake system
  • Handles are adjustable to suit each user's preference
  • Replaceable wheels with multi-color trims will make your cart unique and extraordinary
  • Bag holding rack supports most golf bags of different sizes with adjustable bag strap to secure the golf bag
  • Maintenance free and airless wheels carts are available in Black/Grey/White
  • Beverage holder and umbrella holder included. Perfect for keeping your favorite drink within reach while you relax. Easy store and access your umbrella in case of unexpected rain or bright sunlight.
